title: A known beginning
prompt: You know the message starts with DEAR. Letters of the key = ciphertext minus plaintext. The key is a short word.
hint.1: Compute the first key letters: cipher letter minus D, E, A, R.
hint.2: The key length helper shows the length with the highest score.
hint.3: The first four key letters are K, N, I, F: the fifth completes the word.
